task_title: P1 - /health hangs during in-flight namespace S3 push: make the serving-path namespace auto-commit/push non-blocking
task_criteria: Event-loop proof: a hermetic suite patches the synchronous child-process primitive (execSync/spawnSync) so it blocks ~1500ms and asserts a heartbeat timer on the SAME event loop still fires within 250ms while the namespace commit+push path runs (RED pre-fix: heartbeat delayed >=1500ms or never fires). Suite must be shown RED against pre-fix code.

Serving path non-blocking: no synchronous child-process spawn (execSync/spawnSync) remains reachable from the HTTP/serving write path (debounced commit timer, line-cap flush, first-write git-init path); the only remaining synchronous spawns are the process-exit flush path used by short-lived CLI processes, documented in-code.
Push preserved: with a scratch namespace git repo whose remote is a local bare repo, a namespace write produces a local commit AND the bare remote ref advances to it (AUTOPUSH-001 parity kept).

CLI parity: a short-lived CLI process (duckbrain remember against a scratch namespace with a bare remote) still pushes before exit - the remote ref advances after the process has exited (DOGFOOD-005 exit-flush contract intact).
Bounded and fail-safe: the push keeps a timeout bound (<=30000ms), failures are logged and swallowed (never thrown into the write path), and commit batching/debounce semantics are unchanged.

Gates and docs: npx vitest run green, npx tsc --noEmit exit 0, npx prettier --check src/ clean, integration suite green, and the AGENTS.md count lines synced to the live suite in the same commit (foreman handles AGENTS.md).
